properties.title: Ada National College for Digital Skills Broad Lane campus officially opened
properties.short_description: Ada's institutional history records that its Broad Lane campus in Tottenham Hale was officially opened by the Minister of State for Education in September 2016 after conversion of a former Haringey Council job centre.
properties.explanation: A converted Broad Lane building entered official use as Ada's first London college campus.

properties.title: The Castle Leisure Centre opened at Elephant and Castle

properties.title: citizenM Tower of London opened beside Trinity Square

properties.title: Design Museum reopened in Kensington
